title: Plates Between Candles
summary: Given a string s consisting of '*' (plates) and '|' (candles), and a list of queries, each query specifies a substring of s.
statement: Given a string s consisting of '*' (plates) and '|' (candles), and a list of queries, each query specifies a substring of s. For each query, determine the number of plates within the specified substring that have at least one candle to their left and at least one candle to their right. Return an array where each element corresponds to the answer for the respective query.
constraints: s contains plates * and candles |; each query gives inclusive valid endpoints.
Count plates lying between a candle on their left and a candle on their right within each query.
reference_solution:
def plates_between_candles(s,queries):
    prefix=[0]*(len(s)+1);left=[-1]*len(s);last=-1
    for i,char in enumerate(s):
        prefix[i+1]=prefix[i]+(char=='*')
        if char=='|':last=i
        left[i]=last
    right=[-1]*len(s);last=-1
    for i in range(len(s)-1,-1,-1):
        if s[i]=='|':last=i
        right[i]=last
    answer=[]
    for start,end in queries:
        first=right[start];last=left[end]
        answer.append(0 if first<0 or last<0 or first>=last else prefix[last]-prefix[first])
    return answer
